Ref Arch Build Pipeline

Modular GitHub Actions system for AWS AMI builds, testing, and distribution

Orchestrator Layer
orchestrator-aws-single workflow
orchestrator-gh-release workflow
Module Layer
module-aws-packer-build
module-aws-smoke-test
module-aws-release
module-gh-create-release

module-gh-get-versions
Action Layer
create-aws-template
deploy-cfn
distribute-ami
run-trivy-scan
process-release-files

Prepare Versions

Auto-detect from releases/ directory or validate user-provided list. Outputs JSON matrix.

Packer Build (per version, parallel)

Builds AMI using Packer with version-specific config. In mock mode, reads AMI ID from existing release templates.

skipped if SKIP_BUILD = true (uses mock)

Smoke Test

Generates test template, deploys CloudFormation stack, retrieves instance ID, runs Trivy vulnerability scan via SSM, then tears down the stack.

skipped if SKIP_TEST = true

AMI Distribution

Copies AMI to all target regions, waits for availability, sets public launch permissions on AMIs and snapshots.

skipped if is_supplementary_build = true

Release Template Generation

Injects multi-region AMI map and Lambda code into CloudFormation meta-template. Uploads as artifact.

Commit Release Files

Downloads all artifacts, generates release documentation, commits updated templates and docs back to the repository.

skipped if is_supplementary_build = true

GitHub Release

Archives artifacts into per-version zips, generates SLSA provenance attestation, publishes GitHub Release.

attestations skipped if GENERATE_ATTESTATIONS = false
